identity.name: Identity
identity.summary: Who you are and who your DA is: the files every session loads at startup.

telos.name: TELOS
telos.summary: Your goals, ideal state and current state; Pulse rings and prioritization read it.

config.name: Core config
config.summary: Install config, your operational rules and settings overlay.

voice.name: Voice
voice.summary: Spoken notifications on Fish Audio; with no key, voice is off and silent.

inference.name: Inference and routing
inference.summary: Which vendor and model unattended jobs, judges and effort routing use.

overage.name: Overage lane
overage.summary: Pay-per-token fallback when a subscription window caps, behind a monthly ceiling.

glance.name: Glance
glance.summary: Typed judgment questions answered by Clef-omni on Cloudflare Workers AI; needs a Cloudflare account ID and API token.

workflows.name: Workflows
workflows.summary: Scheduled and on-demand work: definitions, agent jobs and launchd services.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.summary: The local Life Dashboard at localhost:31337.

memory.name: Cortex memory
memory.summary: Session memory, knowledge archive and the memory reviewer loop.

security.name: Security guards
security.summary: The hosts you own, the patterns that must never leave, and the permission rules and git hooks that enforce it.

achilles.name: Achilles
achilles.summary: Vulnerability registry matched against the stack you declare.

relay.name: Tex / Relay
relay.summary: Text your DA over iMessage through the Relay bridge.
relay.external: The iMessage line runs through a hosted third-party service (Photon Spectrum) and needs a Mac and an iPhone; see the guide.

hermes.name: Hermes sidecar
hermes.summary: Optional second front door with its own heartbeat and domain allowlist.
hermes.external: The Hermes agent itself is a separate install, not part of this release.

people.name: People
people.summary: One record per person, synced from Apple Contacts and mail, with an interaction ledger.

location.name: Location
location.summary: Where you are, from your phone via Overland and a Cloudflare Worker.
location.external: Needs the Overland iPhone app and a Cloudflare Worker you deploy yourself; the shipped deploy script calls a skill that is not in this release.

dictation.name: Dictation
dictation.summary: Foot pedal and hotkey driven dictation into the terminal.

socrates.name: Socrates
socrates.summary: Standing questions answered on a schedule, with findings routed to action.

errata.name: Errata
errata.summary: The complaint ledger that turns misses into checks.

finances.name: Finances
finances.summary: Accounts, spend, revenue and investments for Pulse /finances and money answers.

health.name: Health
health.summary: Apple Health and Oura imports for the health dimension.

work.name: Work tracking
work.summary: Your work repo, companies and labels for the work board.

google.name: Google credentials
google.summary: OAuth client for Gmail, Calendar and YouTube tools.

content.name: Content and publishing
content.summary: Brand, themes, email template, YouTube and book settings used by content tools.

evals.name: Assay evals
evals.summary: Eval suites, judge calibration and taste labels.

skills.name: Skill customizations
skills.summary: Per-skill preferences under CUSTOMIZATIONS/SKILLS that override shipped defaults.

workers.name: Digital workers
workers.summary: Named digital employees beside your DA, with presets and a registry.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.summary: Local capture of current state that feeds memory and TELOS.

frontdoors.name: Codex front door
frontdoors.summary: Open the same install from Codex CLI.

statusline.name: Status line
statusline.summary: Terminal status line, quotes and lane extras.

maintainer.name: Maintainer release tooling
maintainer.summary: Release and repo-sync inputs that only the LifeOS maintainer uses.

extractor.name: Extractor noise
extractor.summary: Strings the path extractor matches that are not USER paths.

annualreports.name: AnnualReports
annualreports.summary: Catalog of several hundred cybersecurity annual reports from a public GitHub list, with list, fetch and cross-vendor analysis.

datarefresh.name: DataRefresh
datarefresh.summary: Registry-driven freshness engine that repulls, rebuilds, deploys and live-verifies data-backed sites.

gifts.name: Gifts
gifts.summary: Researches uncommon, current gift ideas for recipients in a registry and keeps history so ideas never repeat.

herdr.name: Herdr
herdr.summary: Operates the herdr terminal workspace manager for coding agents and checks the install, config and agent instructions against upstream.

helm.name: Helm
helm.summary: The reference terminal: kitty with the LifeOS config, the herdr config template, the shell layer and Hammerspoon hotkeys.

securityupdates.name: SecurityUpdates
securityupdates.summary: Ranked, deduplicated security-news digest from six public sources, with state so seen items are not shown again.

spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.summary: Search Spotify, manage playlists and library, and control playback from one CLI.

unify.name: Unify
unify.summary: Harmony analysis across any set of systems, rules or documents, defaulting to all of LifeOS.

brand.name: Brand
brand.summary: Sweeps and refreshes your public bios, profiles, READMEs and ideas page from one surface inventory, with per-surface approval.

dotfiles.name: Dotfiles
dotfiles.summary: Pushes, pulls, syncs, restores and backs up your shell and ~/.config files against a private GitHub repo with secret scanning before every push.

headshot.name: Headshot
headshot.summary: Generates professional AI headshots of you with Nano Banana Pro from your own approved reference photos and stages them for review.

order.name: Order
order.summary: Orders food and goods through DoorDash's official CLI behind an itemized confirmation and a per-order spending ceiling.

prioritize.name: Prioritize
prioritize.summary: Turns the work queue, graded captures, new notes, open upgrades and goals into ranked what-to-work-on recommendations on the Pulse prioritize page.

writing.name: Writing
writing.summary: Writes and repairs prose in your own voice against a measured corpus model, assembles dictated notes, audits text for AI-writing patterns, and reports a Pangram detector score on your own drafts as a quality signal, never a target to beat or a way to pass AI text off as human.

x.name: X
x.summary: Posts, threads, media, Articles, search, bookmarks, profiles and reads on X through the X API v2, with one OAuth 2.0 token store (local file or Cloudflare KV) chosen in config.

restaurants.name: Restaurants
restaurants.summary: Recommends where and what to eat from a household taste profile.

statelog.name: StateLog
statelog.summary: Logs shorthand mood and state entries to a durable journal.

storyexplanation.name: StoryExplanation
storyexplanation.summary: Writes narrative and numbered story explanations in the user voice.

vigil.name: Vigil
vigil.summary: The always-on monitoring layer: one event log, a five-minute tick that routes events by severity to a text, the digest or the dashboard, and a heartbeat.

statvs.name: STATVS
statvs.summary: The one append-only record of what happened across LifeOS and its apps: a local engine that works with no files, and an optional cloud record on your own Cloudflare account.
